source_note: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求
english_source_note: Difference Conditions for Uniform Distribution mod 1
callout_id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#3
statement_en:
If the arithmetic means of a sequence $y_n$ converge to $a$, and its differences satisfy the estimate
$$\Delta y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right),$$
then the limit of $y_n$ exists and is equal to $a$.
callout_body: 如果一个序列$y_n$的算术平均值收敛到$a$,并且其差分具有估计$\Delta y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$那么$y_n$的极限存在且为$a$。
